condition: pyarrow.parquet.write_table raises ArrowNotImplementedError for a table with a union column (sparse or dense), whether it is top-level or nested in a list or struct, because Parquet has no union type.
workaround: Before writing to Parquet, turn the union column into a struct of its child arrays plus a type-code column, or write the table in a format that supports unions, such as Arrow IPC/Feather.
